job.rawJd: About the job. Title: Senior Design Researcher - Innovation & Emerging Technology. Industry: Consumer Technology / AI / Product Design & Research. Location: Remote/Hybrid (Some International Travel Required). Duration: Contract (Leave Coverage). Hourly Rate: $80. We're seeking an experienced Senior Design Researcher to join an innovative research team focused on understanding how culture, human behavior, and emerging technologies will shape the future of products and services. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys uncovering future trends, and can transform research findings into compelling stories that influence business and product strategy. Key Responsibilities: Lead qualitative and generative research initiatives focused on emerging technologies, cultural shifts, and evolving customer needs. Synthesize research findings into actionable insights, frameworks, and strategic recommendations. Create visually compelling presentations, reports, and storytelling artifacts using Figma and AI-powered tools. Facilitate workshops and collaborate with product, design, and research teams to bring insights to life. Conduct in-person and remote research, including ethnographic and contextual field studies. Translate long-term insights into near-term product opportunities and innovation roadmaps. Required Qualifications: 7+ years of experience in Design Research, Innovation Research, Strategic Foresight, or related fields. Strong expertise in qualitative research methods including ethnography, co-design, semiotics, and generative research. Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation communication skills. Proven ability to develop polished, visually engaging research deliverables and executive presentations. Experience influencing product strategy through research-driven insights. Bachelor's degree in HCI, Design Research, Social Sciences, or a related field. Preferred Qualifications: Experience researching AI, XR, AR/VR, connected devices, or digital products. Knowledge of future methodologies, trend forecasting, and emerging technology research. Experience working closely with design, engineering, and business stakeholders. Strong proficiency with Figma, AI tools, and visual storytelling techniques.
